text: The company used an existing AI chatbot platform and configured response templates to answer common customer support questions.

Existing chatbot models failed to correctly classify technical support requests with domain-specific terminology. The team tested multiple custom preprocessing methods, intent classification models, and confidence scoring approaches. Several approaches produced excessive false positives, and the team learned that combining domain-specific tokenization with threshold tuning improved classification reliability.

A logistics software company added a delivery route planning feature using an existing mapping API. The team configured driver locations, delivery addresses, and estimated arrival times. The feature allowed dispatchers to view routes and update deliveries from a dashboard.

A logistics software company attempted to optimize real-time delivery routing for drivers in dense urban areas. Standard route optimization libraries produced unstable results when live traffic updates, driver availability, vehicle capacity, and changing delivery windows were processed at the same time. The team tested multiple custom heuristics and compared their performance against existing algorithms using simulated and historical delivery data. Several approaches failed because they improved route speed but caused missed delivery windows. The team learned that a hybrid scoring method combining traffic volatility, delivery priority, and vehicle load constraints produced more reliable routing decisions under changing conditions.
